title: Pair-encoded list step
statement: For a Boolean list $d$, define a Boolean list by applying the first-component projection to $d$ as the first entry of a pair encoding. The second entry is another pair encoding: its first component is the suffix obtained by dropping a prefix of length specified by the encoding of the first-component projections of the two projections of $d$; its second component is the second projection of the second projection of $d$, followed by an encoding of the corresponding prefix.
caveat: The definitions of `pairEncode`, `pairFstD`, `pairSndD`, `dropPrefixByLen`, and `takePrefixByLen` are not supplied, so the encoding and projections cannot be rendered with fully specified mathematical meanings.
